C005_exhausted.caption:
You "did nothing" all day. So why are you this exhausted? 👀

A meeting.
A ping.
A "quick question?"
Another meeting.

By 5 PM you can't name one thing you finished, and you feel like you ran a marathon.

You're not lazy. Microsoft's 2025 Work Trend Index found workers get about two minutes of uninterrupted time between meetings, emails and messages. That's 275 interruptions a day.

Busy days look like work.
Focus days feel like progress.

Tomorrow, block 90 minutes and set your status: "Heads down until 11. Urgent? Call me." Then take a real lunch, away from your desk.
That's not antisocial. It's how real work gets done.

When was the last time YOU got two quiet hours at work? 👇

Save this for your next "nothing" day, and send it to the coworker drowning in pings.

Follow @unspokenatwork1 now, or you might never see this page again.
